summary: A Yes vote updates the Hayward business license tax with a $60 minimum and rates from $0.30 to $3.75 per $1,000 of gross receipts, raising an additional $12 million annually for general city services until repealed.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve an updated business license tax estimated to raise an additional $12 million annually for general City services.
tax.quote: It is estimated that the updated BLT would annually bring in an additional $12 million to support general City services.

tax.text: A No vote on Measure CC would reject the proposed business-license-tax update, which would generate approximately $12 million in additional annual revenue for city services.
tax.quote: In total, the proposed update would increase annual BLT revenue by approximately $12 million.
